svg.title: M08: measured performance drift and successful alert delivery are separate facts
svg.desc: The slide's frozen baseline 0.900 and current comparable window score 0.792 produce a twelve-percent relative decline. The ten window drops are four, six, three, eight, five, seven, nine, six, four and twelve percent. One window crosses the ten-percent limit; zero violating windows are allowed. M08 creates a deterministic alert intent and M14 records actual delivery and human response separately.
svg.text: M08 · Detect the decline. Preserve the breach and the alert.
Slide teaching values · no executed baseline/window, justified sample size or live delivery is claimed

g.title: A frozen positive baseline is established from separate accepted cases before assessed work
Current window must be fully measured and comparable with its declared baseline
g.text: One canonical result per eligible case

g.title: Relative drop divides the absolute score change by the original baseline

svg.text: TEN MEASURED WINDOWS · ONE CROSSES THE LIMIT · ZERO VIOLATING WINDOWS ALLOWED
Relative drop (%) · exactly 10% is within the limit; a measured value greater than 10% crosses it

g.title: W10 is the only measured crossing; one of ten equals ten percent of windows, exceeding the zero-percent interval allowance
W10: twelve percent, a measured crossing

svg.text: A missing W10 is unknown, not zero drift. Missing windows remain in expected coverage; do not shrink the population.

g.title: Every measured crossing creates an idempotent intent even if an aggregate allowance permits that window
g.text: Window + assessment/spec + measured drop + named recipient
Performance remains BREACHED under the example policy
Intent and actual delivery are separate records

g.title: ServiceNow delivery is verified separately from the human response
g.text: M14 · Deliver and record actual status
PENDING / DELIVERED / FAILED · actual remote record ID
Human response or silence recorded separately
A reply is not required by the hackathon

g.title: The permitted delivery connector consumes the alert intent outside the inference path

svg.text: Successful detection or delivery cannot turn the measured breach into a pass. M06 preserves inputs, results and status history.
Exact-match diagnosis scoring is our proposed metric. Labels and comparable campaign scope require acceptance and verification.
